message: Ruko doesn't tell anyone what to buy, sell or keep. That choice is always yours.
alternative: What Ruko can do: share the message you received, and it will show what this decision means for your own money, your own rules and your exit plan.

terms.title: Share (stock)
terms.brief: A small part-ownership of a company. Its price on the exchange moves as buyers and sellers agree on new prices.
